posts.title: Welcome to my corner of the internet
posts.excerpt: A short introduction to this website and the ideas I hope to share here.
posts.body:
## Why this space exists

This website is a home for my ideas, notes, projects, and longer-form writing.

I want a place that I control, where I can publish at my own pace and organise my work in a way that makes sense to me.

## What to expect

Expect thoughtful essays, practical notes, reflections from projects, and the occasional experiment.
